# Audit your migration

Connect Google Search Console, compare before and after a domain migration, and verify every redirect with the exact numbers Google Search Console reports with the Ultimate Migration Tool.

[Launch Tool](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/app.html)

![SVG Image]

Old domain (before)New domain (after go-live)

## What it measures

There are four numbers every migration pretty much boils down to - clicks, impressions, click-through-rate and average position. The Ultimate Migration Tool helps you to see how your migration has performed, whether that's a domain migration, CMS change or a reskin. The handy timeline shows you the progress of your website migration side-by-side so that you can easily see the before and after.

![Ultimate Migration Tool timeline chart showing clicks, impressions, CTR and position before and after go-live](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/template-assets/img/migrationtimeline.webp)

### Clicks

Before vs after, day by day, aligned on the go-live date for easy viewing.

### Impressions

Visibility of how the migration has performed with keywords, pages and more.

### CTR

Real aggregate: clicks ÷ impressions, never an average of averages.

### Position

Impression-weighted, so low-traffic pages can't flatter the average.

## How it works

The Ultimate Migration Tool runs on our server, with read-only access to your Google Search Console for accurate analysis.

### 1. Connect to Tool

Sign in with Google. We use read-only access only as this tool can never modify a property, and your credentials never reach the browser.

### 2. Map URLs

Upload a CSV of the old URL to the new URL. Skip for a domain-level comparison, or add it for page-by-page accuracy and full migration analysis.

### 3. Collect Data

Wait for a few moments while we gather the data from Google Search Console. Currently limited to maximum of 5,000 URLs per migration.

### 4. Migration Analysis

You get 4 migration reports: main comparison, keyword performance, page-by-page redirects & a migration health dashboard.

![Keyword Analysis report showing clicks, impressions and CTR before and after migration](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/template-assets/img/keywordanalysis.webp)

![Migration Health dashboard showing traffic recovery and risk score](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/template-assets/img/migrationhealth.webp)

## Works for any kind of migration

Not just for domain changes, the Ultimate Migration Tool analyses anything that alters your URLs or shifts your Google Search Console data.

- **Same-domain changes**  
  Site reskins, CMS migrations, URL restructures, or an HTTP to HTTPS move, it's all tracked with the same tool.

- **Domain-to-domain migrations**  
  A ccTLD move like .co.uk to .com, or a full rebrand from one company domain to another.

- **Exact URL matching**  
  http vs https and www vs non-www are treated as genuinely different URLs.

- **Verified, not guessed**  
  Redirects are checked against a real crawl import, and CTR is a true aggregate, not an average of averages.

[Launch Tool](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/app.html)

![Ultimate Migration Tool comparison](https://ultimatemigration.co.uk/template-assets/img/migrationtimeline.webp)

Before/after totals & timeline chart.

## Everything a migration audit needs

Built specifically for the client questions a domain or site migration raises. Best of all, you can tell your manager it was free!

### Two Overlay Comparison Charts

Before/after totals, an aligned overlay chart, and a real-calendar timeline with the go-live date marked.

### Keyword-Level Analysis

Which queries improved, declined, or disappeared entirely after the move.

### Page vs Page Analysis

URL-by-URL migration status, with redirects verified against an imported crawl.

### Server-Side Collection

Runs on our server, not your computer. With read-only Google Search Console access meaning your credentials never reach the browser.

### Exact URL Matching Logic

http vs https and www vs non-www are treated as genuinely different URLs, not merged.

### Redirect Verification Via Crawl

Import a Screaming Frog crawl to verify every redirect chain against your URL mapping.

### Health Dashboard

Recovery timeline projections and a risk score with prioritised recommendations.

### CSV Export

Every report exports cleanly for client presentations and further analysis.

### PDF Export

Download a PDF of the whole page for reporting or sending to clients or managers.

## Ready to see your migration data clearly?

Sign in with the Google account that has Google Search Console access. Free to use.
